chapter: Part 8 - Cursed Child Announcement (June 26th 2015)
text_content:
J.K. Rowling: Today is a very special day for two reasons. Firstly, Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone was published in the UK 18 years ago!
J.K. Rowling: I'm also very excited to confirm today that a new play called Harry Potter and the #CursedChild will be opening in London next year.
J.K. Rowling: It will tell a new story, which is the result of a collaboration between writer Jack Thorne, director John Tiffany and myself. #CursedChild
J.K. Rowling: I don't want to say too much more, because I don't want to spoil what I know will be a real treat for fans. #CursedChild
J.K. Rowling: However, I can say that it is not a prequel! #CursedChild
J.K. Rowling: To answer one inevitable (and reasonable!) question - why isn't #CursedChild a new novel? - I am confident that when audiences see the play
J.K. Rowling: they will agree that it was the only proper medium for the story. #CursedChild
J.K. Rowling: I've had countless offers to extend Harry's story over the years, but Jack, John and Sonia Friedman are a dream team! #CursedChild
J.K. Rowling: It has been a huge pleasure to share with them (and soon, with you!) this untold part of Harry's story. #CursedChild
J.K. Rowling: For all asking for more info on #CursedChild, try http://www.HarryPotterThePlayLondon.com
